📌 Promise check: More than double the $7.25 federal minimum wage

Sen.-elect James Talarico promised this. Here's where things stand:

WHAT'S HAPPENING NOW
• Federal minimum wage: $7.25/hour since 2009
• Texas uses the federal $7.25 minimum
• No federal increase passed since 2009

JAMES'S PLAN
Raise minimum wage over 100%; said '$15 is not going to be enough'

What it needs: Congress passes law, president signs
Status: Not started

He proposes more than doubling $7.25, beyond $15; no exact figure stated.

Do you think this one gets done?

Sources:
https://dub.sh/3YDuTbD
https://dub.sh/X2gQGgG

📌 Promise check: End corporate tax breaks to lower property taxes

Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa promised this. Here's where things stand:

WHAT'S HAPPENING NOW
• School homestead exemption raised to $140,000 (2025)
• Seniors/disabled exemption totals $200,000
• JETI (Ch. 403): 10-year school tax cuts for firms

GINA'S PLAN
'Wipe clean corporate welfare'; use savings to significantly reduce homeowner property taxes.

What it needs: Legislature; governor's office approves some incentive deals
Status: Not started

Her plan names no specific programs to cut or dollar amount for property tax relief.

Do you think this one gets done?

posts.content:
📌 Promise check: Cash back for renters

Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa promised this. Here's where things stand:

WHAT'S HAPPENING NOW
• No state property-tax relief program for renters today
• Renters pay property taxes indirectly, through rent

GINA'S PLAN
'Cut taxes and give cash back to renters'; no amount or mechanism published.

What it needs: Legislature must create and fund a program
Status: Not started

She promised renter cash back but has not published an amount, a cost, or who would qualify.

Do you think this one gets done?

Sources:
https://dub.sh/40mRbLS
https://dub.sh/RrC0eZs
https://dub.sh/Vaip5Yc

#TexasPromiseWatch #txlege

📌 Promise check: Public option for health insurance

Sen.-elect James Talarico promised this. Here's where things stand:

WHAT'S HAPPENING NOW
• No federal public option; marketplace plans are private
• Texas has the highest uninsured rate of any state (U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey, 2024)

JAMES'S PLAN
Create a public option and a Medicare buy-in for all ages

What it needs: Congress passes law, president signs
Status: Not started

No public option exists; he backs one plus a Medicare buy-in.

Do you think this one gets done?

Sources:
https://dub.sh/VQLYFSk
https://dub.sh/97VgaJ7
https://www.census.gov/topics/health/health-insurance.html

📌 Promise check: Repeal 2025 tax breaks for the top 1%

Sen.-elect James Talarico promised this. Here's where things stand:

WHAT'S HAPPENING NOW
• "One Big Beautiful Bill" tax law signed July 4, 2025
• It made the 2017 income tax cuts permanent

JAMES'S PLAN
Undo 2025 tax-law breaks for the top 1% and redirect the money to working families.

What it needs: Congress passes law, president signs
Status: Not started

The repeal is the core promise; where the money goes has shifted during the campaign.

Do you think this one gets done?

https://dub.sh/HR8WYZx
https://dub.sh/yUCD4KN
